Market today: The mood is cautious, especially around the chip sector. News about Nvidia's CEO and potential spy claims is a real driver, casting a shadow on a key player in your concentrated tech/chip book. China's rising wholesale inflation could also squeeze tech supply chains.

Your holdings: You've got a lot of "SELL" signals, especially in leveraged ETFs. SOXL is down a brutal -79.55%, MUU -62.95%, and SPAL -49.5%. These leveraged positions amplify drops, and on margin, that hurts extra. SMCI (-34.46%) and SMH (-27.09%) are also deep in the red.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your leveraged positions, particularly SOXL, MUU, and SPAL. Their decay and amplified moves demand constant attention. Also, watch for any further developments on the Nvidia news, as it could ripple through the entire chip sector.

Bottom line: Your heavy concentration in tech/chips, especially leveraged ones, means you're highly exposed to any negative news in the sector; manage risk aggressively.
plays: SOXL: This 3X leveraged chip ETF is down -79.55% and has a "SELL" status. Consider trimming or exiting to reduce extreme exposure to decay and amplified losses.
MUU & SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are also down significantly (-62.95% and -49.5% respectively) and are "SELL" status. Review their stops and consider reducing exposure to manage margin risk.
SOXS: With negative chip news and your heavy SOXL losses, consider a short-term hedge. Scanner shows a long setup for SOXS at entry 70.75-70.63, stop 69.11.
